description: Deterministic assembly of the two native Valloren map panels into one canonical world raster. Pure integer crop + translate; no resampling, warp, filling or redraw.

output.alpha: flattened onto #ffffff (alpha is 255 everywhere inside the print-margin crop; only the outer frame anti-alias wings are 240-254)

panels.notes: x 58..2481, y 58..3242 (native). Keeps the outer frame (cols 60-64 left, rows 60-64 top, rows 3236-3240 bottom) with a 2 px white margin; cuts 4 columns inside the seam frame (frame wings 2485-2489 are excluded; cols 2482-2484 are clean and duplicated in the east panel).
x 71..2494, y 58..3242 (native). Keeps the outer right/top/bottom frame with a 2 px white margin; drops the seam frame (cols 63-67) and cols 68-70 which duplicate west cols 2479-2481.

seam.registrationMethod: Hex-lattice phase on both sides of the joint (local lattice fits give east->west x shift 2411.1 mod the 104.86 px lattice period) cross-checked by coastline/hill-stroke continuity at 3x zoom. The panels overlap by 6 native columns (west 2479-2484 = east 68-73); the frames are print-tile frames, not geography.
seam.cutNote: West is used up to native x 2481, east from native x 71 (= west 2482): the cut lies inside the 6-column overlap, in clean (frame-free) pixels on both sides.
